# SCRUM-17 - Review a submitted event request

**Superseded in part** (the criteria below are kept as accepted in Sprint 1):

* **AC2, superseded by SCRUM-141 AC1 and AC3:** Coordinators, Venue Staff and Technical Support Staff see every event except Drafts, read-only, in the all-events list.
* **AC2, superseded by SCRUM-165 AC3 and SCRUM-141:** the Event Coordinator Lead sees unassigned requests in the Unassigned queue and every event in the all-events list.
* **AC2, superseded by SCRUM-166 AC2:** a Safety Officer sees an event's arrangements read-only when reviewing its safety check.
* **AC2, superseded by SCRUM-165 AC8:** a Coordinator can't open an unassigned request for decision.

**As an Event Coordinator**, I want to open and review the full details of a submitted event request, so that I can assess whether it's ready to move forward.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

* Coordinator can view all fields the Organiser submitted (name, purpose, dates, attendance, venue/accessibility/equipment/registration needs)
* Only Event Coordinators and the request's own Organiser can view a request's details (role-based access; see the Access Control epic)

**INVEST:** Independent (a read-only view, needed regardless of how approval later works); Negotiable (layout of the review screen is open); Valuable (a Coordinator can't assess anything without seeing it); Estimable/Small (one detail view); Testable (visible fields match what was submitted; access is blocked for other roles).
